Esri en National Geographic lanceren MapMaker

📅 2026-04-15 🏷️ MapMaker, education, Esri, National Geographic, classroom GIS
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Esri and National Geographic are repackaging layered digital cartography into a Dutch-language classroom tool that makes GIS exploration more accessible in secondary education.

📌 Key takeaways

  • This Geografie.nl piece reports the Dutch launch of MapMaker, a classroom-oriented mapping application developed by Esri and the National Geographic Society.
  • The key point is not technical novelty but pedagogical packaging.
  • MapMaker is also framed as a possible alternative to Google Maps in classroom use.
  • The launch also reflects a broader trend in GIS: lowering the entry barrier for non-specialist users without abandoning the logic of layered spatial analysis.
  • The article ends by inviting teachers to contribute ideas for future layers and lesson materials, which reinforces that the product is being positioned as a participatory educational platform rather than a finished static package.
